title: Bracket
noneYet: No bracket has been generated for this stage yet.
generateDesc: Order teams by seed (top = seed 1). Untick a team to leave it out.
regenerateWarn: Regenerating wipes the current bracket; it is only allowed while no real match has been completed.
seedsFromStage: These are the teams in this stage, in the order they qualified. Reorder or untick before generating.
seedsFromGroup: These are the teams in this group, in the order they were added. Reorder or untick before generating.
seedsFromRegistrations: No teams have been added to this stage yet, so every registered team is listed. Reorder or untick before generating.
needThree: Double elimination needs at least 3 teams selected.
tiesNotAllowed: Ties are not allowed in elimination brackets.
tiesAllowed: Ties are allowed in league play.
toastComplete: Bracket complete. Placements written to the leaderboard.
thirdPlaceHint: The two beaten semi-finalists play each other. The winner takes 3rd and the loser 4th, instead of both sharing 3rd.
playerStatsHint: Optional. Enter what each player did in this set. Leave blank for 0. These feed player profiles and the ranking ladders.
noRoster: No players on this roster yet.
schedHint: Players are notified when you set or change the time.
pickWinner: Pick the team that goes through.
bestOfHint: This room is set to {rounds} rounds, so it is first to {n}.
agreement_one_side: Only one team has sent theirs
rejectReasonPrompt: Why are you rejecting this? The team will read it.
toastSubmitted: Sent. The organizer will review it.
submitOurResultHint: Send in what happened and the organizer confirms it. Put the scores in the order shown.
roomSettingsThisMatch: Room settings for this match only
roomInheritedFrom: These are inherited from the {scope}. Saving creates settings just for this one.
roomOwnSettings: These settings belong to this one.
roomNoneYet: Nothing is configured yet, so this starts from a fresh room.
roomLoadFailed: Could not load the room settings.
roomSaveFailed: Could not save the room settings.
roomPresetModesHint: One tap sets the rest. You can still change anything afterwards.
roomBestOfHint: First to {n} round wins takes the set.
roomNoAreas: This map has no separate areas to pick.
roomPublish: Show the room ID and password to players
roomPublishHint: Off until you are ready. Turning it on tells both teams the room is open.
roomNotOpenYet: The organizer has not opened the room yet.
